title: 做了10年会计后，他用无代码工具杀出一条血路
title_en: After 10 Years in Accounting, He Used No-Code to Break Through
title_jp: 10年会計をした後、ノーコードで血路を開く
title_ar: بعد 10 سنوات في المحاسبة، استخدم بدون كود ليشق طريقه

{"ops": [{"insert": "做了10年会计后，他用无代码工具杀出一条血路"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": {"image": "https://storage.googleapis.com/indie-hackers.appspot.com/post-images/J3hjYbiRydch9He95ukv/vOqaQ3DJwYRP8MNEjUOSMger71w1/kieran-ball-founder-of-bullet-launch.png"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你有没有想过——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "在70,000人的大公司做一颗螺丝钉，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "是什么感觉？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Kieran Ball知道。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他是会计。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不是最出色的员工。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不喜欢有老板。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不喜欢没有自主权。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不喜欢按别人的时间表生活。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不喜欢做无意义的小任务。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不喜欢被 pigeon-holed 到只做一种专业工作。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "还有所有权的问题。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "领工资方便容易，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但他知道——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他创造的大部分价值都去了公司，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最终到了股东手里。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这就是系统的运作方式。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "如果你对公司来说不比他们付你的工资更有价值，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们就不会雇你。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【2008年的转折点】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2008年，Kieran读了《每周工作4小时》。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "被 online 卖数字产品的想法 hook 住了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他记得一个叫IDoneThis的App——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "就给团队成员发邮件问今天做了什么，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后 collate 回复。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这种 simple apps 看起来 achievable，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以他试着学编程——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "用Codecademy和其他教程。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但不知为什么，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他的笔记本 dev environment 总是崩。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Never gave up，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但也 never reached 能 ship app 的地步。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "试过找技术 cofounder，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但 ultimately 他的想法都 terrible——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "主要是社交网络——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "而且他对 marketing 一无所知。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "谢天谢地，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他从来没有 conviction 投入大量时间或钱在任何想法上，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "因为它们都会失败。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【2019年遇见GlideApps】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Kieran认为整个 no-code SaaS 产品的概念被忽视了——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "被那些只在乎技术栈、"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不 look at 下面商业 fundamentals 的人忽视。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2019年，他在Product Hunt上发现了一个叫GlideApps的 no-code app builder。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Mind blown。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "No-code 正是他需要的。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Launch 了几个MVP，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但很快 hit Glide 的 limitations。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后，他找到了Bubble.io。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Instantly hooked。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "比其他任何工具都更灵活、更强大。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他这时候已经 reasonably technical，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "对 apps 怎么 work 有 decent understanding，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "而 Bubble 对他就是 make sense。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从建最简单的 functional page 开始，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后开始在一个SaaS项目上 work，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "边做边学。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Bubble 有 amazing community 和 forum，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以任何问题的答案都 readily available。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "几个月内，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他建了第一个 full SaaS 产品——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一个视频 testimonial 工具，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "在它们 trendy 之前。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "产品失败了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他没有 market 它，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " initial users 就是不用。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他 assumed 视频 testimonials 不会成气候，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " move on 了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "结果一年后，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Damon Chen launch Testimonials.to，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " made a killing。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【成为Bubble自由职业者】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他 keep building SaaS 项目，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后 abandon 它们，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "因为他太 much in "builder" mindset，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "完全不 think like founder。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但每个 build 都学到新 skills，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以他 soon quit 工作，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " become freelancer，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "为最大的 Bubble agencies 之一工作。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这需要学他们的 build 方式，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "第一次让他的 apps 被 professionals review。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这是 brilliant experience——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "学了很多 best practices，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " confidence 增长。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "事实上，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他现在的 boilerplate project 用了很多那里学的 best practices。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Anyway，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他对用 Bubble build 太 excited 了，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "开始录 tutorials 和 courses 教别人怎么做。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "收入 significant proportion 开始来自这个，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "而不是 freelancing，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以 freed up time 做更多 SaaS 项目。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【Yep.so：25000美元出售】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有一个SaaS成了 small success。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "叫Yep.so——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " lightning fast landing page builder，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " for validating ideas。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Grew to 700美元MRR，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但 growth stagnated，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最后卖了25000美元。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最近又被卖了，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " pretty cool。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【Bullet Launch：无代码模板】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在他的 main product 是一个叫 Bullet Launch 的 SaaS boilerplate。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "帮 no-coders 和 visual developers——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有技术技能但不会写代码的人——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " launch SaaS 项目快得多。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "带大量 detailed documentation 和 videos，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以有点 course 和 boilerplate 二合一。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这个想法酝酿了很久，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "因为他 continually found himself wasting time"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "建同样的 basics 进每个 SaaS 项目。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后2023年底，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Bubble 引入了新功能——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "可以 detach reusable elements，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "终于能建自己的 functional UI components，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " cross app reuse。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他也 aware boilerplates 越来越 trendy，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "当然，他 can't help but notice Mark Louvion 的 Ship Fast 成功。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他知道 boilerplates 变成了 indie hacker cliché。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但在 no-code 世界，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "它们实际上 quite rare，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有 real need。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他见过用 Bullet Launch 建的 amazing products，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "通常在 interesting、underserved niches，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "传统开发者很少存在的地方。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "好例子——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一个 brand consultant 建了 SaaS 解决他现有客户的问题。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Bullet Launch是一次性购买，不是 recurring revenue。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "原价199美元，几个月前涨到249美元。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "用 Bubble build，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "内置 Open AI、Postmark、Loops（email）、"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Stripe、Lemonsqueezy（订阅）集成。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "今年3月8日 launch。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Launch 以来平均每月3300美元，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "扣除 Bubble marketplace fees。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【其他项目】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他还有几个其他项目："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Create With：", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "AI + no code podcast、newsletter、conference。还 pretty new，所有收入都 reinvest 回公司。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "The NoCode Solopreneur：", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "4500订阅的 newsletter，写用 no-code 工具建 business。是漏斗 top，不 monetize。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Course sales：", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "每月约2000美元，autopilot。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Freelancing：", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "其余收入来自 freelancing，每周约10小时。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "还在做几个 SaaS 项目，但 nothing worth showing yet。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【Distribution is everything】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "当人们说"distribution is everything"，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " don't ignore them and carry on building。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这真的是 most important thing。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "也 much harder than you think，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "需要 real time 和 dedication 学习。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "如果你想建 successful SaaS，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " focus on growing your marketing skills。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他的 marketing 主要在 X 和 email newsletter，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " LinkedIn 上有一小部分。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从2019年起在 X 建了3万粉丝，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "知道他是发 no code、indie hacking、SaaS 的。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "LinkedIn上1300粉丝。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Newsletter 4500订阅。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "No-code SaaS boilerplate 和他现有内容 fit well，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "容易 weave 进他的 narrative。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这对他 big difference，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "因为他不 enjoy trying contrive ways promote products。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【社交媒体营销】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他就发关于新功能的 updates、"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "特别 proud 的 parts 的 screenshots、"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "或者人们用它建什么的 anecdotes。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "尽量每天在 Twitter 上发至少一次。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "担心人们会 sick of hearing about it，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但 realistically，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "只有 small number of people 看到每条 post，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以他们 not being bombarded。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最近给 Bullet Launch 建了 Twitter profile，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这样可以 tag @usebulletlaunch 而不是 include URL，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "因为 URLs decrease reach。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他注意到关于 software 表现最好的 posts 倾向于 attach beautiful screenshots，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以尽量 attach nice images when he can get them。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "People also respond well to short videos。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他用一个叫 Screen Studio 的 amazing indie app 做 videos。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【Newsletter营销】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他还在 newsletter 加了 footer，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " borrowed from Justin Welsh's newsletter。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "说"When you're ready，here are some ways I can help you…""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "列出 boilerplate 和 Bubble course。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Generally，每条 newsletter 至少产生一个或多个 sales。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【长期游戏】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Kieran最喜欢的 indie hacking quote 来自 Courtland Allen——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "大意是："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""每个人内心都有一个成功的公司，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "唯一的变量是他们能不能 keep going long enough to find it"。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "既然不知道它什么时候来，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他的建议是 optimize your process for the long game。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这就像——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " join gym 几个月 vs 完整的健康生活方式改变。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他见过 community 里很多人来来去去。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们 get excited，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " launch 一堆东西，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " then get disillusioned，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " eventually go back to normal job。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他 plan to keep trying and failing until he succeeds。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Start by thinking——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""What do I need to put in place to keep this up for at least the next 10 years？""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这可能意味着 stay in day job you don't love，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "或 reduce living expenses 和 work part time。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "也意味着 find ways consistently test 和 shut down ideas"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "with minimal expenditure of time、effort、emotional energy。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Ultimately，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "意味着你必须 make the journey enjoyable for yourself。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他和 Ben Tossell（sold Makerpad、"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " founded Bens Bites 的 no-code OG）"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有过有趣的 exchange。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Ben指出时间其实不是 success 的主要因素——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " number of attempts 才是。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "如果你是个 spend a year on each attempt 的人，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "找到 success 可能比 spend a month 的人 take much longer。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这就是 no-code（和 boilerplates）make so much sense 的原因。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【目标：5万美元MRR】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这就是他的 approach——长期思考。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "过去10年的 number one goal 是 launch 和 grow successful indie SaaS product。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "如果能建到5万MRR，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他会 consider that goal achieved。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "除此之外，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "只想 spend more time with family，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " take nice holidays，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " enjoy life。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【你的十年计划是什么？】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Kieran的故事告诉我们——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从会计到 no-code 创业者。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从70,000人公司的一颗螺丝钉，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "到控制自己 destiny 的 solopreneur。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不是 overnight success。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "是10年的学习、失败、坚持。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他 quote Courtland Allen——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "每个人内心都有一个成功的公司，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "唯一的变量是能不能 keep going long enough。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你呢？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你在为你的长期游戏 optimize 吗？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "还是只打算 try 几个月，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "如果不 work 就 quit？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "如果 Kieran 可以试10年，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你为什么不能？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "*P.S. 想学 no-code 建 SaaS？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "关注 Kieran 的 X 和 newsletter。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "或者看看 Bullet Launch——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "也许你的下一个 SaaS，"}, {"insert": "

content_en: After 10 Years as Accountant, He Used No-Code Tools to Break Through. Have you thought about what it's like to be a small cog in a 70,000-person company? Kieran Ball knows. He's an accountant. Not the best employee. Doesn't like having a boss. Doesn't like lack of autonomy. Doesn't like living by someone else's schedule. Doesn't like doing meaningless minor tasks. Doesn't like being pigeon-holed to only one type of professional work. There's also the ownership issue. Getting salary is convenient easy, but he knows most value he creates goes to company, ultimately to shareholders. That's how the system works. If you're not more valuable to company than what they pay you, they won't hire you. In 2008, Kieran read The 4-Hour Workweek. Hooked by idea of selling digital products online. Remembers app IDoneThis: sent team members emails asking what they did today, then collated replies. These simple apps seemed achievable, so he tried learning programming using Codecademy and tutorials. But his notebook dev environment never worked properly.
content_jp: 10年間会計士をしてから、彼はノコードツールを使って血路を開いた。7万人いる会社の小さな歯車になるのがどんな感じか考えたことがある？Kieran Ballは知っている。彼はあるちっぽけな производит в 70,000人の会社ではなく、会计士。的最佳员工ではない。上司がいないのが好きじゃない。自主性が Lack なのも好きじゃない。 他人のスケジュールで生きるのが好きじゃない。意味のない小さなタスクをするのが好きじゃない。1種類の専門作業に pigeon-holed されるのが好きじゃない。所有権の問題もある。給与もらうのは convenient easy だけど、、彼は知っている——自分が作る価値のほとんどは会社に行く、最終的に株主に行く。これがシステムの运作方式。あなたが会社にとって彼らが支払う給与より有价值でなければ、彼らはあなたを雇わない。2008年、Kieranは『週4時間労働』を讀んだ。オンラインてデジタル製品を販売するアイデアに夢中になった。IDoneThisというAppを覚えている——チームメンバーに今日何を上げたかをメールして、返事を collate する。これらの simple apps は達成可能に見えた 그래서彼はCodecademy和其他教程を使ってプログラミングを学ぼうとした。
content_ar: بعد 10 سنوات كمحاسب، استخدم أدوات بدون كود لكسر الطريق. هل فكرت ما الذي يشبه أن تكون ترسًا صغيرًا في شركة تضم 70,000 شخص؟ Kieran Ball يعرف. إنه محاسب. ليس أفضل موظف. لا يحب وجود رئيس. لا يحبLack of autonomy. لا يحب العيش حسب جدول شخص آخر. لا يحب أداء مهام صغيرة عديمة المعنى. لا يحب أن pigeon-holed لوظيفة مهنية واحدة فقط. هناك أيضًا مسألة الملكية. الحصول على الراتب ملائم وسهل، لكنه يعرف أن معظم القيمة التي يخلقها تذهب للشركة، في النهاية للمساهمين. هكذا يعمل النظام. إذا لم تكن أكثر قيمة للشركة مما يدفعونه لك، فلن يستأجرك. في 2008، قرأ Kieran كتاب 4-Hour Workweek. انجذب بفكرة بيع المنتجات الرقمية عبر الإنترنت. يتذكر تطبيق IDoneThis: أرسل لأعضاء الفريق رسائل يسألهم ماذا فعلوا اليوم، ثم جمع الردود. بدت هذه التطبيقات البسيطة قابلة للتحقيق، لذلك حاول تعلم البرمجة باستخدام Codecademy ودروس.
